module_metadata.purpose: Lifecycle virtual methods, Tween.tween_await() (4.7), Resource.duplicate_deep() (4.5+), Signal, Node, SceneTree, and @GlobalScope utility functions.

lifecycle_virtual_methods._init: func _init() -> void: # Called when Object.new() is allocated in memory (before entering SceneTree).
lifecycle_virtual_methods._enter_tree: func _enter_tree() -> void: # Called when node enters SceneTree (before children are ready).
lifecycle_virtual_methods._ready: func _ready() -> void: # Called once after node and all children have entered SceneTree and @onready vars are initialized.
lifecycle_virtual_methods._process: func _process(delta: float) -> void: # Called every visual frame. DO NOT query PhysicsDirectSpaceState here!
lifecycle_virtual_methods._physics_process: func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void: # Called every fixed physics tick. Query direct_space_state and move_and_slide() here.
lifecycle_virtual_methods._unhandled_input: func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void: # Use for gameplay input after UI Controls have had a chance to consume events.

tween_4_7_api.tween_property: tween.tween_property(object: Object, property: NodePath, final_val: Variant, duration: float) -> PropertyTweener

tween_await_4_7_new.description: NEW in Godot 4.7: Pauses an active Tween sequence in-place until `sig` emits, eliminating the need to split a tween into separate `await` coroutines.
tween_await_4_7_new.example:
var tween: Tween = create_tween()
tween.tween_property(card, ^"offset_transform_scale", Vector2(1.1, 1.1), 0.2)
tween.tween_await(confirm_button.pressed)
tween.tween_property(card, ^"modulate:a", 0.0, 0.25)

interruptible_tween_chain_rule.rule: When a UI banner or animation can be interrupted and restarted (`_active_tween.kill()`), NEVER `await _active_tween.finished` in a coroutine followed by `await get_tree().create_timer()`. Killing a tween never emits `.finished`, leaking the suspended coroutine or leaving orphaned timers! Instead, encode the entire sequence inside a single `Tween` using `tween.chain()`, `tween.tween_interval(duration)`, `tween.tween_await(signal)`, and `tween.tween_callback(hide)`.

resource_duplication_4_5_to_4_7.rule: Overhauled in 4.5-4.7 for deterministic deep copying of nested Typed Arrays, Typed Dictionaries, and embedded sub-resources.

character_body_signatures.move_and_slide: move_and_slide() -> bool # Takes ZERO arguments in Godot 4.x; uses built-in `velocity` property.
